title: サステイナブル建築
subtitle: Sustainable Architecture
keywords: Long life and reuse of building
educationalGoal: Learn what sustainable building is based on basic knowledge of architectural planning, structural planning, environment, planning, materials and construction planning. Learn the requirements of sustainable architecture and the means to achieve them. The goal is to be able to set planning, design, construction and maintenance standards for sustainable buildings. Students will also learn about sustainable architecture in cooperation with the local community.
advice:
1. Learn what is sustainable. (Terms, historical background, construction market trends)
2. Learn what building evaluation is. (Overview of building evaluation, evaluation items of various buildings, green buildings in each country)
3. Learn about the elements of sustainable architecture. (Long life, coexistence with nature, energy saving, resource saving / circulation saving, inheritance, etc.)
4. Learn what life cycle management is. (Life cycle cost, facility management, building diagnosis / long-term maintenance plan)

Lectures and case studies based on handouts will be provided. Preparing and reviewing the contents of lectures using handouts to deepen understanding.
requiredKnowledge: To read architectural magazines (new architecture, Nikkei Architecture, etc.) and newspapers from everyday, and to know the social trends surrounding architecture.
